title: Clearer next steps for workspace access requests
summary: Colleagues waiting to join a company workspace now see their request status, approver contacts and a way to check for approval, without being prompted to connect Microsoft 365 again. Owners and admins see pending request counts and a direct link to review requests. Declined requests remain visible with instructions for getting an invitation, and decision emails are sent when email is configured. Approval still grants viewer access; no one receives access automatically.
